title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a vendor credit belongs to its return or vendor
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with two unused vendor credits: vendor credit A, from a vendor return made at location B, and vendor credit B, entered directly (not from a vendor return) while signed in at location A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with the Vendor filter showing vendor A ticked and its group expanded.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location of vendor credit A and vendor credit B.
  2. In the Location menu, untick location A.
  3. Expand vendor A's group.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor credit A shows location B (the return's location).
  • Vendor credit B shows location A (the vendor's location for that credit, where it was entered, as today).

Step 2:

  • The report narrows to location B.

Step 3:

  • Only vendor credit A is listed.

A vendor has no single location of its own: each bill or credit is written to the vendor's account at one location, and that is the location it shows (tech plan, 21 Oct 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications, Q2 A/P row location: “A vendor account is per (vendor, location) on every write path (delivery, manual credit, return credit), so vendor_account.workplace_id already is the document's location.”
  • Tech plan §3 D13: “Equal to S5-R7's per-document rule by construction (every write path finds or creates the (vendor, location) account); prod 0 mismatches.”
